evidence.claim: The Pritzker Architecture Prize identifies the architect as Alejandro Aravena, born in 1967, and records his leadership of ELEMENTAL.
ELEMENTAL lists the UC Anacleto Angelini Innovation Center in its official project archive.
ELEMENTAL lists EDP Headquarters in its official project archive.
The project engineering consultant identifies EDP Headquarters II in Lisbon and credits Architecture to Elemental S.A.

The canonical aravena row contains the full multilingual biography and all three style/era relations. The misspelled duplicate contains only a one-line English biography, has no UUID relations, and is referenced only by the two reviewed building slugs.

guardrails: Refuse if either architect row differs from the reviewed production IDs and identity fields.
Refuse unless exactly the two reviewed buildings still reference the misspelled slug.
Refuse if the duplicate architect gains any UUID foreign-key relation.
Do not alter building identity, content, image, taxonomy, or graduation data.
Keep a permanent redirect from the misspelled public route to /architect/aravena.
